verdict.rationale: Greenhouse ships AI features (Notetaker, Voice AI, Talent Matching, Offer Forecast), so whether customer data can be excluded from AI model training is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions training data usage, an opt-out control, or a no-training commitment. The 'no data silos' Notetaker claim concerns tool consolidation, not training, and does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
